entries.en: The laboratory's spreading factor sample lost activity before the comparison could begin.
entries.zh: 比较尚未开始，实验室的那份透明质酸酶样品就失去了活性。

entries.en: A spring peeper appeared beside the ruler in the student's enlarged photograph.
entries.zh: 学生的放大照片里，标尺旁有一只雨蛙。

entries.en: The staghorn sumac hid the broken fence from the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 从厨房窗户望去，鹿角漆树挡住了那道破损的围栏。

entries.en: The stannic chloride container was still sealed when the laboratory inspection began.
entries.zh: 实验室检查开始时，装着四氯化锡的容器仍未开封。

entries.en: The star-nosed mole crawled beneath the wooden shelter in the observation enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只星鼻鼹鼠爬到了观察围栏内的木制遮蔽物下面。

entries.en: Her drawing of the stinking iris lay unfinished beside the open window.
entries.zh: 她那幅红籽鸢尾画还没有完成，放在敞开的窗户旁。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the stinking nightshade without stepping inside the fenced plot.
entries.zh: 植物学家没有走进围起来的地块，就拍下了那株黑莨菪。

entries.en: A fallen bucket partly covered the stone bramble beside the old shed.
entries.zh: 一个倒下的桶遮住了旧棚屋旁的一部分石生悬钩子。

entries.en: The gardener found strawberry blite behind the stack of empty pots.
entries.zh: 园丁在那堆空花盆后面发现了头状藜。

entries.en: They moved the bench away from the strawberry guava before painting it.
entries.zh: 他们先把长椅从那株草莓番石榴旁移开，再给长椅刷漆。

entries.en: A strawberry shrub occupied the corner where the broken water barrel had stood.
entries.zh: 一株洋腊梅属灌木长在原先放着破水桶的角落里。

entries.en: The striped hyena walked past the camera while the keeper checked the outer gate.
entries.zh: 饲养员检查外门时，那只黑纹灰鬣狗从相机前走过。

entries.en: The cobbler brushed dust from the suede leather before examining the torn seam.
entries.zh: 鞋匠先刷掉绒面革上的灰尘，再查看破开的接缝。

entries.en: Sulfur bacteria were visible in the enlarged image of the collected sample.
entries.zh: 所采集样本的放大图像中可以看见硫菌。

entries.en: The summer cypress brushed against the wheelbarrow as she pushed it through the gate.
entries.zh: 她推独轮车过门时，地肤擦过了车身。

entries.en: The artist placed a swamp azalea in the foreground of her garden painting.
entries.zh: 画家在她那幅花园画的前景画了一株杜鹃。

entries.en: A close photograph of swamp dewberry filled the first page of his field notebook.
entries.zh: 他的野外笔记本第一页上是一张占满整页的硬毛黑莓特写照片。

entries.en: We left our bicycles beside the swamp maple and walked to the cottage.
entries.zh: 我们把自行车留在红花槭旁，步行去了小屋。

entries.en: The overturned sign concealed the lower stems of the swamp milkweed.
entries.zh: 倒下的标牌遮住了沼泽马利筋的茎下部。

entries.en: The sweet flag beside the pond appeared in every photograph of the little bridge.
entries.zh: 每张拍摄那座小桥的照片里，都有池塘旁的菖蒲。

entries.en: He retrieved his dropped notebook from beneath the sweet gale.
entries.zh: 他从香杨梅下面捡回了掉落的笔记本。

entries.en: The torn jacket left a strand of synthetic fiber caught on the nail.
entries.zh: 破夹克上的一缕合成纤维挂在了钉子上。

entries.en: The laboratory found tannic acid in the stained material from the old workshop.
entries.zh: 实验室在来自旧作坊的那份染色材料中检测到了鞣酸。

entries.en: The nineteenth-century pharmacy kept tartar emetic in a drawer behind the counter.
entries.zh: 那家十九世纪的药房把酒石酸锑钾存放在柜台后面的抽屉里。

entries.en: The tartaric acid sample arrived after the laboratory had completed its other measurements.
entries.zh: 实验室完成其他测量后，那份酒石酸样品才送到。

entries.en: The hospital returned the tetanus antitoxin because the parcel's seal had been broken.
entries.zh: 包裹封口已破损，医院因此退回了那批破伤风抗毒素。

entries.en: An emergency delivery of tetanus immune globulin reached the pharmacy after midnight.
entries.zh: 紧急配送的破伤风免疫球蛋白在午夜后送到了药房。

entries.en: The chemist requested another analysis of the unidentified tetrabasic acid.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员要求对那种尚未鉴定的四元酸再做一次分析。

entries.en: The faulty sensor invalidated the measurements of thiocyanic acid.
entries.zh: 传感器故障使硫氰酸的测量结果失去了效力。

entries.en: The laboratory repeated the thyrotropic hormone assay after discovering a calibration error.
entries.zh: 发现校准错误后，实验室重新进行了促甲状腺激素检测。

entries.en: The botanist sketched the tick trefoil growing beside the greenhouse door.
entries.zh: 植物学家画下了温室门旁生长的那株山马蝗属植物。

entries.en: The tiger salamander remained under the leaf while the camera recorded the enclosure.
entries.zh: 相机拍摄围栏内的情况时，那只虎螈一直待在叶子下面。

entries.en: The laboratory detected tobacco mosaic virus in the damaged seedling's sample.
entries.zh: 实验室在那株受损幼苗的样本中检出了烟草花叶病病毒。

entries.en: The laboratory could not identify the transuranic element in the sealed sample.
entries.zh: 实验室无法鉴定那份密封样品中的超铀元素。

entries.en: The traveller's tree cast a shadow across the empty courtyard bench.
entries.zh: 那株旅人蕉的影子落在了院子里的空长椅上。

entries.en: The laboratory rejected the contaminated trichloracetic acid sample.
entries.zh: 实验室弃用了那份受污染的三氯乙酸样品。

entries.en: A damaged balance interrupted the team's measurements of triphosphoric acid.
entries.zh: 一台损坏的天平中断了团队对三磷酸的称量。

entries.en: She threaded a tusk shell onto the cord beside a wooden bead.
entries.zh: 她把一个角贝壳穿在线绳上，挨着一颗木珠。

entries.en: The analysis found an unsaturated fatty acid in the residue on the damaged bowl.
entries.zh: 分析在那个受损碗的残留物中检测到了一种不饱和脂肪酸。

entries.meaningZh: 草酸双氧铀〔较旧化学名称〕
entries.en: An independent laboratory examined the sealed uranyl oxalate sample after the storage cabinet was damaged.
entries.zh: 储存柜受损后，一家独立实验室检查了那份密封的草酸双氧铀样品。

entries.en: The archived specimen tested positive for varicella zoster virus.
entries.zh: 那份存档标本的水痘-带状疱疹病毒检测结果为阳性。

entries.en: A digital model of variola major virus rotated slowly on the museum's screen.
entries.zh: 博物馆屏幕上的一个重型天花病毒数字模型在缓缓旋转。

entries.en: The exhibition projected an enlarged image of variola virus onto the curved wall.
entries.zh: 展览把天花病毒的放大图像投影到了弧形墙面上。

entries.en: The varnish tree blocked our view of the gardener's cottage from the path.
entries.zh: 那棵漆树挡住了视线，使我们从小径上看不到园丁的小屋。

entries.en: A torn vascular bundle was clearly visible in the enlarged section of the stem.
entries.zh: 在放大的茎切片上，可以清楚地看见一束撕裂的维管束。

entries.en: The cracked basin had been carved from verd antique.
entries.zh: 那个开裂的盆是用古绿石雕成的。

entries.en: The mason rejected the block of verde antique because one corner had broken off.
entries.zh: 石匠弃用了那块杂蛇纹石，因为它的一角已经断掉了。

entries.en: A vinegar fly settled on the rim of the empty jam jar.
entries.zh: 一只果蝇落在了空果酱瓶的瓶口上。

entries.en: Wall barley had grown around the base of the abandoned bicycle.
entries.zh: 那辆废弃自行车的底部周围长出了鼠大麦。

entries.en: The botanist knelt beside the wall rocket to retrieve her dropped pencil.
entries.zh: 植物学家在细叶二行芥旁跪下，捡回了掉落的铅笔。

entries.en: A water gum stood beside the empty picnic shelter in the survey photograph.
entries.zh: 调查照片里，空无一人的野餐遮蔽棚旁长着一棵水紫树。

entries.en: The camera recorded a small fish swimming through the water milfoil.
entries.zh: 相机拍到了一条小鱼游过狐尾藻属植物的场景。

entries.en: An earlier analysis had overlooked the water of crystallization in the sample.
entries.zh: 先前的一次分析忽略了样品中的结晶水。

entries.en: The water shrew crossed the observation tank before the student could focus her camera.
entries.zh: 学生还没来得及对好焦，那只水鼩就穿过了观察箱。

entries.en: The house painter found that the wetting agent container had leaked inside the equipment box.
entries.zh: 油漆工发现，装着润湿剂的容器在设备箱里漏了液。

entries.en: A Japanese white birch stood behind the bench where we left our camera bags.
entries.zh: 一棵白桦立在那张长椅后面，我们把相机包留在了长椅上。

entries.en: The white bryony had twined around the broken handle of the old watering can.
entries.zh: 那株白泻根缠住了旧浇水壶的断提手。

entries.en: She moved the white currant away from the gate before carrying in the new bench.
entries.zh: 她先把那株白果红茶藨子从门旁移开，再把新长椅搬进去。

entries.en: The white fir cast a long shadow across the newly repaired garden wall.
entries.zh: 那棵白冷杉在新修好的花园围墙上投下了长长的影子。

entries.en: The illustrator photographed the white hellebore before the visiting group entered the garden.
entries.zh: 参观团进入花园之前，插画师拍下了那株白藜芦。

entries.en: A white-footed mouse ran behind the bucket when the shed door opened.
entries.zh: 棚屋的门打开时，一只白足鼠跑到了桶后面。

entries.en: The wild cherry leaned over the narrow footbridge beside the cottage.
entries.zh: 那棵野樱树斜伸到小屋旁的狭窄步行桥上方。

entries.en: A fallen label lay beneath the wild marjoram in the display bed.
entries.zh: 展示花坛里的牛至下面有一块掉落的标牌。

entries.en: The wild parsley partly concealed the cracked base of the garden ornament.
entries.zh: 野欧芹遮住了那件花园装饰品开裂底座的一部分。

entries.en: The photographer stepped back to include the wild parsnip in the frame.
entries.zh: 摄影师向后退了一步，把那株欧洲防风草也纳入了取景范围。

entries.en: We waited beneath the willow oak until the gardener unlocked the side gate.
entries.zh: 我们在柳栎下等候，直到园丁打开了侧门的锁。

entries.en: The winter crookneck had spread across the broken trellis.
entries.zh: 那株南瓜沿着破损的棚架蔓延开来。

entries.en: The wood fern beside the stairway appeared in the corner of her photograph.
entries.zh: 她的照片一角拍到了楼梯旁的一株鳞毛蕨属蕨类。

entries.en: A pot of wood hyacinth stood beside the artist's unfinished landscape painting.
entries.zh: 画家那幅未完成的风景画旁放着一盆蓝绵枣儿。

entries.en: She found her missing key beneath the wood sorrel beside the porch.
entries.zh: 她在门廊旁的酢浆草下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

entries.en: The enlarged photograph showed a Rocky Mountain wood tick beside a ruler.
entries.zh: 放大的照片中，一只安氏革蜱位于标尺旁。

entries.en: A leaking bottle of wood vinegar stained the supplier's paperwork.
entries.zh: 一瓶漏液的木醋弄脏了供应商的文件。

entries.en: The laboratory questioned the identity of the xanthic acid sample after the labels were mixed up.
entries.zh: 标签被弄混后，实验室对那份黄原酸样品的身份产生了疑问。

entries.en: The yellow jessamine behind the fountain was partly hidden by the photographer's umbrella.
entries.zh: 喷泉后面的常绿钩吻被摄影师的伞挡住了一部分。

entries.en: The gardener photographed the yellow sweet clover before moving the empty pots beside it.
entries.zh: 园丁先拍下了黄香草木犀，再挪动它旁边的空花盆。

entries.en: The yolk sac was visible near the edge of the enlarged embryo image.
entries.zh: 放大的胚胎图像边缘附近可以看见卵黄囊。

entries.en: The damaged zinc sulfide crystal could no longer be used in the demonstration.
entries.zh: 那块受损的硫化锌晶体已经不能再用于演示了。

entries.en: The corgis crowded around the empty basket while their owner fetched fresh blankets.
entries.zh: 主人去拿干净毯子时，那些威尔士矮脚狗挤在空篮子周围。

entries.en: The hellebores in the drawing were partly covered by a spilled cup of tea.
entries.zh: 一杯打翻的茶水盖住了画中那些藜芦的一部分。

entries.en: The aardwolves remained behind the rocks while the keeper checked the outer fence.
entries.zh: 饲养员检查外围围栏时，那些土狼一直待在石头后面。

entries.meaningZh: 银白杨〔较少用英语名称的复数〕
entries.en: Three abeles blocked our view of the little cottage from the road.
entries.zh: 三棵银白杨挡住了视线，使我们从路上看不到那间小屋。

entries.en: The restorer cleaned the carved acanthuses above the doorway without disturbing the surrounding paint.
entries.zh: 文物修复人员清理了门口上方雕刻的莨苕叶形装饰，没有碰动周围的油漆。

entries.en: The chromatogram showed several acetals in the recovered mixture.
entries.zh: 色谱图显示，回收的混合物中含有几种缩醛。

entries.meaningZh: 顶生植物〔旧分类名称，复数〕
entries.en: The curator moved the preserved acrogens into a separate cabinet during the renovation.
entries.zh: 装修期间，馆长把保存的顶生植物标本挪到了一个单独的柜子里。

entries.meaningZh: 海葵〔较少用英语名称的复数〕
entries.en: The actinias were clearly visible through the viewing window despite the scratched glass.
entries.zh: 尽管玻璃有划痕，仍能从观赏窗清楚地看见那些海葵。

entries.en: The microscope image showed aerobes clustered near the edge of the sample.
entries.zh: 显微图像显示，需气生物聚集在样本边缘附近。

entries.en: The shipment was rejected after the laboratory detected aflatoxins in a grain sample.
entries.zh: 实验室在一份谷物样本中检出黄曲霉毒素后，那批货被拒收了。

entries.en: The agapanthuses in her painting were partly hidden by the frame's wide lower edge.
entries.zh: 画框宽大的下边框遮住了她画中爱情花的一部分。

entries.en: The agarics beside the fallen branch were partly hidden beneath a discarded glove.
entries.zh: 落枝旁的那些伞菌被一只丢弃的手套遮住了一部分。

entries.en: The laboratory detected alloantibodies in the stored serum samples.
entries.zh: 实验室在储存的血清样本中检出了同种抗体。

entries.en: Two life-size models of allosaurs stood on either side of the museum's entrance.
entries.zh: 博物馆入口两侧立着两座与实物大小相当的异龙模型。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the aluminates found in the damaged ceramic samples.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了那些受损陶瓷样品中发现的铝酸盐。

entries.meaningZh: 阿米巴；变形虫〔美式拼写，复数〕
entries.en: The amebas moved beyond the edge of the microscope's field of view.
entries.zh: 那些变形虫移出了显微镜的视野。

entries.en: The chemist examined the ammines in the newly labelled vials.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员检查了那些新贴好标签的小瓶里的氨合物。

entries.en: The biologist compared the amnions in two prepared embryo specimens.
entries.zh: 生物学家比较了两份制好的胚胎标本中的羊膜。

entries.en: The anacondas remained out of sight while the keeper replaced the broken lamp.
entries.zh: 饲养员更换破灯时，那些水蟒一直没有露面。

entries.en: The angelfishes swam together when the keeper lowered the divider.
entries.zh: 饲养员放下隔板时，那些天使鱼一起游动了起来。

entries.en: The angleworms crawled out of the bait box while he searched for his fishing rod.
entries.zh: 他找钓鱼竿时，那些用作钓饵的蚯蚓从饵盒里爬了出来。

entries.en: Two anhingas flew across the field of view as I adjusted the telescope.
entries.zh: 我调整望远镜时，两只美洲蛇鸟飞过了视野。

entries.en: The hospital compared the delivery dates of the antivenins before updating its inventory.
entries.zh: 医院比较了那些抗蛇毒血清的送达日期，随后更新了库存记录。

entries.en: Mud clung to the horse's hooves after the walk.
entries.zh: 散步后，那匹马的蹄子上沾着泥。

entries.meaningZh: 爱侣〔亲昵或打趣用语，复数〕
entries.en: The lovebirds held hands under the table while everyone else argued about the bill.
entries.zh: 其他人都在争论账单时，那对爱侣在桌子底下牵着手。

entries.meaningZh: 人工合成绝缘材料〔复数〕
entries.en: The engineers compared several synthetics for the cable's electrical insulation.
entries.zh: 工程师们比较了几种用于电缆电绝缘的人工合成材料。

entries.en: Please readdress the parcel before the courier collects it this afternoon.
entries.zh: 请在快递员今天下午取件前，更改包裹上的收信人地址。

entries.en: Her first novel succeeded financially but failed literarily.
entries.zh: 她的第一部小说在商业上获得了成功，但在文学上却失败了。

entries.en: Her reading subscore improved, although her overall test result barely changed.
entries.zh: 她的阅读分项分数提高了，尽管考试总成绩几乎没有变化。

entries.en: The actor looked calm onscreen, although he had been terrified during filming.
entries.zh: 那名演员在银幕上看起来很镇定，尽管拍摄时他曾十分害怕。

entries.en: She learned to waterski during a holiday with her school friends.
entries.zh: 她和学校的朋友们度假时，学会了进行水橇滑水。

entries.en: The town continues to underuse its recently renovated library.
entries.zh: 镇上那座刚翻修过的图书馆仍未得到充分利用。

entries.en: The festival is unbanning cameras after complaints from last year's visitors.
entries.zh: 收到去年参观者的投诉后，那个节庆活动正在解除相机禁令。

entries.en: She could not unlove him simply because he had moved away.
entries.zh: 她不能仅仅因为他搬走，就不再爱他。

entries.en: The apartment was stupefyingly expensive, even without the parking space.
entries.zh: 即使不包括停车位，那套公寓也贵得令人震惊。

entries.en: He lived decadently, gambling away the money intended for his children's education.
entries.zh: 他生活堕落，把原本用于孩子们教育的钱赌光了。

entries.en: After weeks of rain, the old path was veritably a stream.
entries.zh: 连着下了几周雨后，那条旧小路真成了一条小溪。

entries.en: She groped sightlessly for the light switch in the dark.
entries.zh: 黑暗中，她什么也看不见，摸索着寻找电灯开关。

entries.meaningZh: 使不受新法律规定的约束
entries.en: The new licensing law grandfathered businesses that had already opened.
entries.zh: 新的许可法让此前已经开业的企业免受新规定的约束。

entries.en: The goalkeeper was showboating for the cameras instead of watching the ball.
entries.zh: 那名守门员正在镜头前炫耀，而没有盯住球。

entries.en: The chef butterflied the chicken before placing it on the tray.
entries.zh: 厨师把鸡切开摊平后，才放到托盘上。

entries.en: The alarm was shatteringly loud in the narrow passage.
entries.zh: 狭窄的通道里，警报声响得令人震惊。

entries.en: I tried to relight the candle, but another gust blew through the open window.
entries.zh: 我试着重新点燃蜡烛，但敞开的窗户又吹进了一阵风。

entries.en: After rereading the draft, she decided to reincorporate the deleted paragraph.
entries.zh: 重读草稿后，她决定把删掉的那段文字重新并入。

entries.en: The carpenter returned to refix the window catch that had come loose.
entries.zh: 木匠回来，准备重新安装那个已经松脱的窗扣。

entries.en: He tapped meaninglessly on the desk while waiting for the meeting to begin.
entries.zh: 等候会议开始时，他毫无目的地敲着桌子。

entries.en: The marker travelled ballistically after it was released from the test rig.
entries.zh: 标记物从试验装置释放后，按弹道运动。

entries.en: The small publisher operates transnationally, with editors working in three different countries.
entries.zh: 那家小型出版社开展跨国经营，编辑分处三个不同的国家工作。

entries.en: The room felt indefinably different after he moved the old piano.
entries.zh: 他挪动那架旧钢琴后，房间让人觉得有了某种说不清的变化。

entries.en: The congregation read the psalm responsively with the minister.
entries.zh: 会众与牧师以应答的方式诵读了诗篇。

entries.en: She returned to the bench whereon she had left her gloves.
entries.zh: 她回到先前放下手套的那张长椅旁。

entries.en: Constantly changing the targets can demotivate employees who have worked hard to meet them.
entries.zh: 不断更改目标，会让那些一直努力达标的员工失去动力。

entries.en: He cravenly blamed the apprentice for his own mistake.
entries.zh: 他懦弱地把自己的错误归咎于学徒。

entries.en: The subsea cable was damaged by an anchor during the storm.
entries.zh: 风暴期间，那条海底电缆被锚损坏了。

entries.en: The farmer abandoned intercropping after the trial plots proved too difficult to manage.
entries.zh: 试验田被证实太难管理后，那位农民放弃了间混作。

entries.en: The two violins differed tonally, although their prices were almost identical.
entries.zh: 两把小提琴在音色方面有所不同，尽管价格几乎一样。

entries.en: The narrow gate was open, but the handcart could not get thro.
entries.zh: 狭窄的大门开着，但那辆手推车过不去。

entries.meaningZh: 绝对地〔不附限定；拉丁语借词，正式用语〕
entries.en: The committee judged the proposal unacceptable simpliciter, not merely too expensive.
entries.zh: 委员会认为该提案本身就不可接受，而不只是费用太高。

entries.en: I agreed to childmind for our neighbours while they attended the meeting.
entries.zh: 我答应在邻居们开会时替他们照看孩子。

entries.en: The guard spoke intimidatingly to anyone who approached the locked door.
entries.zh: 凡是走近那扇锁着的门的人，保安都会用威胁的口气对他们说话。

entries.en: The cat stretched lithely across the warm blanket before curling up beside me.
entries.zh: 那只猫在暖和的毯子上舒展着柔软的身体，随后蜷缩在我旁边。

entries.en: The joints had been soldered unprofessionally and came apart during the inspection.
entries.zh: 那些接头焊得不专业，检查时就散开了。

entries.en: The workers stopped to stook the wheat before the rain reached the field.
entries.zh: 雨水到达田间之前，工人们停下来堆放麦束。

entries.meaningZh: 重新找到〔refind 的过去式〕
entries.en: She refound the missing necklace beneath the loose lining of her suitcase.
entries.zh: 她在手提箱松脱的衬里下面重新找到了那条丢失的项链。

entries.en: The two routes differed negligibly in length but took very different amounts of time.
entries.zh: 两条路线的长度差异可以忽略不计，所需时间却相差很大。

entries.en: The crew mutinously refused to return to work until the captain addressed their complaints.
entries.zh: 船员们以反抗的姿态拒绝复工，直到船长回应了他们的申诉。

entries.en: The assistant mislabeled the parcel and sent it to the wrong office.
entries.zh: 助手给包裹贴错了标签，把它送到了错误的办公室。

entries.en: She textualized the recorded interviews before beginning her analysis.
entries.zh: 她把录下的访谈转成文字后，才开始分析。

entries.en: He wanted a durably bound notebook that could withstand daily travel.
entries.zh: 他想要一本装订结实耐用、经得住日常旅途折腾的笔记本。

entries.en: We learned to orienteer in the park before entering our first race.
entries.zh: 我们先在公园里学会了定向赛跑，然后才首次参赛。

entries.en: The workshop planned to turbocharge the engine, but the owner cancelled the project.
entries.zh: 修理厂原计划用涡轮给这台发动机增压，但车主取消了该项目。

entries.en: The material shortage would foreseeably delay the project, so the manager revised the timetable.
entries.zh: 可以预见，材料短缺会拖延项目，因此经理修改了时间表。

entries.en: The developers restored the testbed after a failed software update.
entries.zh: 软件更新失败后，开发人员恢复了试验台。

entries.en: The training helped staff recognize phishing before they entered their passwords.
entries.zh: 培训帮助员工在输入密码前识别网络仿冒行为。

entries.en: The overman counted the workers as they returned from the mine.
entries.zh: 工头清点了从矿井回来的工人。
